skillFindings.ownerComparison: Arcadia's realtime-3D card addresses ownership, ordering, repeatable profiles and budgets. The specialist adds purpose-derived streams, canonical edges/corners, persistent overlays, actual-rule state search, consumable/irreversible transitions, inconclusive search limits and validated bounded recovery.
skillFindings.mechanics: The entrypoint and methods separate semantic from byte replay, derived base from authoritative saves and success witnesses from incomplete search. Boundary repair must respect committed neighbors; regeneration scope and save migration are explicit.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Seed-set variety, rejection distribution and search/generation cost remain separate from validity and human play. The method warns against making every output trivial to increase acceptance.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Impossible constraints, stale generation versions, missing neighbor geometry, exhausted search and invalid fallback have explicit outcomes. No engine technology or universal performance values are imposed.
skillFindings.guarantees: No reachability-to-fun or screenshot-to-runtime guarantee; runtime witness validation remains required.

skillFindings.ownerComparison: Prometheus provides broad operational planning and evidence-led prioritization. The specialist owns queue reconciliation, original/stage age, effective capacity without double subtraction, decision/delegate boundaries, unavailable-decider fallback and bounded exceptions.
skillFindings.mechanics: It reconciles arrivals/completions/rework/transfers, distinguishes active effort from delay and constrains WIP/intake at the actual bottleneck. Decision requests, choices and implementation remain different.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: It weighs delayed work and displaced commitments instead of maximizing local utilization or prescribing meetings. Stable-flow conditions limit the WIP/throughput cross-check; variable staffing/demand qualify pilot interpretation.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Missing timestamps, absent deciders, expired exceptions, full WIP and downstream congestion have workable responses. Silence is not authority, and account/messages are not implied.
skillFindings.guarantees: A plan, fewer meetings or a dashboard change is not operational improvement. No mandatory Lean/OKR hierarchy or fixed utilization target was inherited.

skillFindings.ownerComparison: Beacon provides offer architecture, cohort measurement and subscription recovery. The specialist adds charging-unit/meter/bill mechanics, tier jobs, cost-to-serve scenarios, assignment identity, contribution per eligible buyer and renewal/discount/proration checks.
skillFindings.mechanics: It separates contribution from profit/cash, avoids double-netting fees/refunds and preserves cohort denominators, sales overrides and immature follow-up. Hybrid units and specific bounded test prices remain available.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Bill predictability, adoption friction, service cost, cannibalization and renewal exposure can conflict with conversion; package testing does not silently isolate price when multiple factors change.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Failed metering or assignment contamination blocks interpretation and calls for repair or a fresh test. Heavy usage, expiry, duplicate exposure and migration have explicit checks.
skillFindings.guarantees: No price optimum, universal sample threshold, survey-intersection demand guarantee or early-profit extrapolation. Root license signals do not become source-specific clearance.

skillFindings.ownerComparison: Logos primarily owns evidence-bound reports, editorial/documentation and factual artifact structure. This specialist owns actual fictional drafting, particular desire/pressure, scene/emotional turns, reader versus character knowledge and saved branch consequences.
skillFindings.mechanics: It produces the requested text, preserves canon/belief/unreliability distinctions, permits quiet/nonlinear/lyrical forms and orders revision from causal movement to prose. Branch entry/effects/rejoin and stable node/save identity are implementable.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Branch/content budgets and structural coherence support rather than override artistic intent. Meaningful permanent divergence, heightened voice and unresolved mystery remain permissible; compression is not universal.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Contradictory rejoin, missing nodes, impossible conditions and revised downstream scenes have concrete checks/fallbacks. Reader observations and runtime rendering remain separate evidence.
skillFindings.guarantees: No forced convergence, naturalism mandate, prewriting bureaucracy, fixed consequence timing or statistical beauty claim inherited from source.
